source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify the areas that did not meet safety standards.
3. Compile detailed notes on non-compliance points.
4. Take photographs or videos to document unsafe conditions, if permissible.
5. Interview employees or supervisors responsible for the areas in question to gather additional context.
6. Reference applicable health and safety regulations or standards violated.
7. Prepare a report summarizing findings and listing specific violations.
8. Attach all relevant documentation including inspection forms, photos, and interview notes.
9. Include recommendations for corrective actions and timelines for compliance.
10. Secure the report and ensure it is readily accessible for review by appropriate personnel and external parties (regulators, insurance, etc.).
11. Document the times and dates when safety issues were communicated to management and any immediate actions taken.
12. Record any feedback or pushback from management, and document attempts at negotiation and resolution.
13. Archive all communications related to the audit, including emails and meeting notes.
14. Maintain confidentiality
